function localArrays() {
  interface Array<T> { consume: (value: T) => void; }
  interface ReadonlyArray<T> { consumeReadonly: (value: T) => void; }
  const wide: Array<string | number> = {consume: value => console.log('array', value)};
  const narrow: Array<string> = wide;
  const wideReadonly: ReadonlyArray<string | number> = {consumeReadonly: value => console.log('readonly', value)};
  const narrowReadonly: ReadonlyArray<string> = wideReadonly;
  narrow.consume('hi');
  narrowReadonly.consumeReadonly('there');
}
function localContainers() {
  interface ReadonlyMap<K, V> { consume: (key: K, value: V) => void; }
  interface ReadonlySet<T> { consume: (value: T) => void; }
  interface ArrayIterator<T> { consume: (value: T) => void; }
  const map: ReadonlyMap<string | number, string | number> = {consume: (key, value) => console.log(key, value)};
  const narrowMap: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = map;
  const set: ReadonlySet<string | number> = {consume: value => console.log('set', value)};
  const narrowSet: ReadonlySet<string> = set;
  const iterator: ArrayIterator<string | number> = {consume: value => console.log('iterator', value)};
  const narrowIterator: ArrayIterator<string> = iterator;
  narrowMap.consume('key', 3);
  narrowSet.consume('item');
  narrowIterator.consume('step');
}
function localInference() {
  interface Iterable<T> { value: T; }
  interface ArrayLike<T> { value: T; }
  interface IterableIterator<T> { value: T; }
  function iterableValue<T>(input: Iterable<T>): T { return input.value; }
  function arrayLikeValue<T>(input: ArrayLike<T>): T { return input.value; }
  function iteratorValue<T>(input: IterableIterator<T>): T { return input.value; }
  const first = iterableValue({value: 'one'});
  const second = arrayLikeValue({value: 2});
  const third = iteratorValue({value: true});
  const one: string = first;
  const two: number = second;
  const three: boolean = third;
  console.log(one, two, three);
}
function localFunction() {
  interface Function { value: number; }
  const value: Function = {value: 1};
  console.log(String(value));
}
class Numbers extends Array<number> {}
const numbers: Array<string | number> = new Numbers(1, 2);
const readonlyNumbers: ReadonlyArray<string | number> = [3, 4];
const readonlyMap: ReadonlyMap<string | number, string | number> = new Map<string, number>([['x', 5]]);
const readonlySet: ReadonlySet<string | number> = new Set<string>(['y']);
const iterator: ArrayIterator<string | number> = [6].values();
localArrays();
localContainers();
localInference();
localFunction();
console.log(numbers, readonlyNumbers, readonlyMap.get('x'), readonlySet.has('y'), iterator.next());
